Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal for the next meeting: technical deep dive (system architecture, integration patterns, and spike plan for the POC).
- Success criteria (from your team): confirm latency/cost envelope, KV-cache patterns for session data, and integration points for your ingest pipeline.

Proposed slots (all PT):
1) Wed, Jul 7 — 10:00–11:00 PT (60m)
2) Thu, Jul 8 — 13:00–14:00 PT (60m)

Please let me know which option works best and who from your side will attend so we can loop in the right engineers. I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines agenda and required artifacts; we’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom link once the slot is locked.

Attendees we recommend from Redwood:
- Aisha Rahman — Solutions AE (will lead discovery recap & MAP)
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer (will lead technical deep dive)
- Neha Kapoor — Customer Success (onhand for POC ops)

Attachment: HealthMesh_MAP_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Best,
Aisha Rahman

aisha.r@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks — once we lock the time we’ll confirm Rahul/Alyssa availability.

On Wed Jul 7 availability: 11:00 PT is my preference.
